svg.title: Lumen Health · Operating Structure, Q3 2026
svg.desc: A top-down organisational chart for a seventeen-person health-software company, four reporting levels deep. Amara Osei, the chief executive, sits at the top with a chief of staff attached by a short line to the right rather than hanging below as a direct report. Four executives report to her: the chief technology officer, the VP of product, the VP of revenue and the VP of finance and operations. Under engineering, two directors each carry a short stacked list of leads; one of those slots, the mobile platform lead, is an unfilled vacancy drawn as a dashed amber card with a plus sign in place of initials. A dashed violet line runs from the head of design across the bottom of the chart and into the web engineering lead, marking design-system accountability that crosses departments without being a reporting line. Each card is white with a three-pixel department-coloured bar across its top edge and an initials disc filled in the same colour; the department name underneath is plain grey text. A legend at the foot names the five department colours and the four line and card conventions.

svg.text: 17 people · four reporting levels · five departments
